def compare_water_models(panel, pressure):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
    from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
    from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
    features = ["Solids_log1p", "ph_distance_7", "Sulfate", "Trihalomethanes"]
    cols = ["row_order"] + features + ["Potability"]
    data = panel[cols].merge(pressure[["row_order", "pressure_count"]], on="row_order", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
    data = data.sort_values("row_order", kind="stable").dropna(subset=features + ["Potability"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    X = data[features].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    y = data["Potability"].to_numpy(dtype=int)
    order = data["row_order"].to_numpy(dtype=int)
    train_idx, test_idx = train_test_split(np.arange(len(data)), test_size=0.30, random_state=42, shuffle=True, stratify=None)
    train_min = X[train_idx].min(axis=0)
    train_max = X[train_idx].max(axis=0)
    span = train_max - train_min
    span[span == 0] = 1.0
    X_scaled = (X - train_min) / span
    q1, q3 = pressure["pressure_count"].quantile([0.25, 0.75])
    test = data.iloc[test_idx].copy()
    low_nonpotable = (test["pressure_count"] <= q1) & (test["Potability"] == 0)
    high_potable = (test["pressure_count"] >= q3) & (test["Potability"] == 1)
    models = {
        "depth_3_decision_tree": DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3, random_state=42),
        "100_tree_random_forest": RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
    }
    rows = []
    for name, model in models.items():
        model.fit(X_scaled[train_idx], y[train_idx])
        pred = model.predict(X_scaled[test_idx])
        actual = y[test_idx]
        full_error = float(np.mean(pred != actual))
        precision = float(np.sum((pred == 1) & (actual == 1)) / np.sum(pred == 1)) if np.sum(pred == 1) else None
        subgroup_metrics = []
        for label, mask in [("low_pressure_nonpotable", low_nonpotable.to_numpy()), ("high_pressure_potable", high_potable.to_numpy())]:
            n = int(mask.sum())
            err = float(np.mean(pred[mask] != actual[mask])) if n else None
            subgroup_metrics.append((label, n, err))
        rows.append({
            "model": name,
            "test_rows": int(len(test_idx)),
            "potable_precision": precision,
            "full_test_error_rate": full_error,
            "low_pressure_nonpotable_rows": subgroup_metrics[0][1],
            "low_pressure_nonpotable_error_rate": subgroup_metrics[0][2],
            "low_pressure_nonpotable_error_minus_full": None if subgroup_metrics[0][2] is None else subgroup_metrics[0][2] - full_error,
            "high_pressure_potable_rows": subgroup_metrics[1][1],
            "high_pressure_potable_error_rate": subgroup_metrics[1][2],
            "high_pressure_potable_error_minus_full": None if subgroup_metrics[1][2] is None else subgroup_metrics[1][2] - full_error
        })
    result = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("model").reset_index(drop=True)
    winner = result.sort_values(["potable_precision", "model"], ascending=[False, True]).iloc[0]
    result["precision_winner"] = winner["model"]
    result["winner_potable_precision"] = float(winner["potable_precision"])
    return result
